title: Add per-row AL performance guidance
summary: New performance guidance documents how to use SetAutoCalcFields for per-row FlowFields and how to avoid cloning records before Modify or Delete in loops, with corrections to the commit checkpoint sample.
key_points: New guidance and AL samples for using SetAutoCalcFields with per-row FlowFields
New guidance and samples for avoiding cloning records before Modify or Delete in loops
Commit-checkpoint sample corrected: selects at most 500 ordered keys into a temporary buffer, then locks and processes only those keys
Performance review skill gained precise cues for per-row Commit and clone-before-write, with exclusions for valid checkpoints and direct writes
CalcSums remains the rule for a single filtered-set aggregate
